nodes.label: Java/Python Responsibility Split
nodes.source_file: docs/artifacts/SURGE — Smart Utility Routing and Grid Evacuation.md
nodes.rationale: The split keeps authentication, transactions and project ownership in Java while keeping scientific types and solvers in Python; Java serializes stored WTGs and substations and calls Python synchronously, then stores returned metrics and route features.
